title: Client submissions
purpose: Find client declarations sent for laboratory review and intake.
summary: The sample submissions clients have sent for laboratory review, and the accepted ones whose samples are still to be received.

tasks.title: Review new submissions
steps: Open a submission number to accept it into intake or return it to the client.

tasks.title: See which accepted shipments are still to arrive
steps: Set [[Status]] to Accepted and select [[Apply]]. Awaiting receipt counts the samples not yet received.

tasks.title: Find a client's submission
steps: Type a submission number, COC reference, client, project or client sample ID in [[Search]], or pick a [[Client]].

good_to_know: Clients create and submit submissions in their portal. Staff do not create them here.
Client drafts never appear, so the Draft filter returns no rows.
Accepted is not receipt. Samples count as received only once each is received from the submission page.
Expected arrival is the client's plan. A past date does not flag the shipment as overdue.

sections.title: Access
paragraphs: Custodians and project managers can review submissions and receive samples. Admins inherit these operational roles. Client accounts cannot use staff intake pages.

sections.title: Find and arrange records
paragraphs: There is no bulk action or selection across pages. Invalid filters show errors and no rows; correct or clear them. No matches means the filters found nothing. An unfiltered empty list means no eligible records exist.

items.label: Search
items.description: Search submission number, COC reference, client, project and declared client sample ID. Case-insensitive partial matching trims surrounding spaces and accepts at most 200 characters. Search and filters apply together to the full record set.

items.label: Status
items.description: All sent submissions initially: Submitted, Returned for changes, Accepted and Cancelled. Draft is offered as a filter but client drafts are always excluded, so it gives no rows.

items.label: Client
items.description: Any client initially; restrict to one. Inactive clients remain available for existing records.

items.label: Apply
items.description: Apply search and filters and return to page 1. Current sorting and page size are kept.

items.label: Clear all
items.description: Remove search, filters, sorting and page settings and return to this list’s defaults. Removing one active filter keeps the others and returns to page 1.

items.label: Sort
items.description: Most recently submitted first. Select a sortable heading to change direction. Sortable columns: Submission, Status, Client, Project, COC reference, Samples, Awaiting receipt, Expected arrival and Submitted. Sorting applies to all matching records, with record identity as a stable tie-breaker.

items.label: Rows per page
items.description: 25 by default; choose 50 or 100. A change returns to page 1 and preserves other query settings. Show applies the choice without automatic submission.

items.label: First page / Previous page / Next page / Last page
items.description: Move through matching records. The footer shows the visible range, count and page. Unavailable directions are disabled. Invalid page numbers resolve to an available page; unsupported page sizes are refused.

items.label: Columns
items.description: With enhanced controls, show/hide columns and use Move up / Move down or drag headings to reorder. Submission is always shown and fixed. Changes apply immediately and are saved for your account for this table; they do not filter or change records.

items.label: Reset columns / Done / Close
items.description: Reset columns restores shipped visibility and order. Done or Close dismisses the Columns dialog; changes already apply.

items.label: Submission
items.description: Assigned SUB number; open to review declarations and intake actions.

items.label: Status
items.description: Submitted awaits review; Returned for changes allows client correction; Accepted opens intake; Cancelled marks a shipment not arriving.

items.label: COC reference
items.description: Declared chain-of-custody reference for matching paperwork.

items.label: Awaiting receipt
items.description: For Accepted submissions, number without a linked received sample. Other states show a dash. Acceptance is not receipt.

items.label: Expected arrival
items.description: Declared date or a dash if unstated; not an automatic overdue flag.

sections.title: Next step
paragraphs: An empty queue means no eligible declarations have been sent. Clients create and submit declarations through their portal; staff do not create them from this list.
